answer: 无法按所问完整比较。ToG 的具体检索流程：所提供的 ToG 论文片段只描述 ToG-R 与 ToG 的关系，称“ToG-R sequentially performs relation search, relation prune and entity search in each iteration, which is the same as ToG”[chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4]，并称 ToG-R 相比 ToG“eliminates the need for the process of pruning entities using the LLM”[chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4]；因此可确认 ToG 流程中使用 LLM 进行实体剪枝，但 LLM、实体关系和文档在“从问题到证据”各步骤中的完整参与方式，所给证据不足。ToG-2：原文称其“achieves in-depth and reliable context retrieval through the guide of KGs and performs precise graph retrieval by treating documents as node contexts”[chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2]，并“iteratively performs a collaborative retrieval process based on KG and text”[chunk_c9284a24e2b28b371a7e43a2bc6ae3c2]；这支持 KG 引导、文档作为节点上下文、KG 与文本协同迭代检索，但未给出逐步的 LLM 决策与实体关系扩展细节。两篇论文的定位比较仅有结论性表述：“ToG performs well in scenarios that demand rapid, triplet-based reasoning, while ToG-2 demonstrates its strength in cases requiring detailed contextual reasoning”[chunk_dbc1fae04646d9e523a5b16481732daf]，不能据此推断两条完整流程图或各组件参与顺序。
